# iximiuz-labs_roadmap (Resource)

Manages an iximiuz-labs roadmap.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Note: Roadmap creation via the API is not yet supported.
# This resource is a placeholder for future functionality.
# Applying this configuration will fail with an HTTP 404 error.
resource "iximiuz-labs_roadmap" "example" {
  name_prefix = "my-roadmap"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_prefix` (String) A name prefix for the roadmap. The API will append a unique suffix to produce the final `name`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the roadmap was created.
- `name` (String) The roadmap name (slug), assigned by the server.
- `page_url` (String) The roadmap web URL.
- `title` (String) The roadmap display title.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the roadmap was last updated.
